observed: Paired original-frequency stratified batches achieved lower fold1 fit error and S ensemble CE, yet source-heldout M and S errors both rose sharply; 6-fit primary gate failed.
required_action_for_related_future_plan: Do not repeat this batch configuration or treat lower fit error, CE, or frozen-gradient variance as classification benefit; report fresh paired M/S outcomes across all source-closed folds and keep the failed large groups in the denominator.
decision: Stop the registered B batch branch; no 12 confirmation fits, no threshold/weight rescue, no promotion.
scope: Previously inspected official development folds; not a proof of universal impossibility or external transfer.
